text: 【财政部拟发行2026年记账式贴现（六十期）国债 招标面值总额350亿元】财政部拟发行2026年记账式贴现（六十期）国债。本期国债为期限91天的贴现债。本期国债竞争性招标面值总额350亿元，进行甲类成员追加投标。
text_en: [The Ministry of Finance plans to issue the 2026 book-entry discount (60th tranche) government bonds, with a total tendered face value of 35 billion yuan] The Ministry of Finance plans to issue the 2026 book-entry discount (60th tranche) government bonds. This tranche is a 91-day discount bond. The competitive tender face value total for this tranche is 35 billion yuan, with additional bidding by Class A members.
